headline: Capri Global Capital Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Capri Global Capital Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e., October 14, 2026, has considered and approved the Raising of funds up…
detail: General Updates - Capri Global Capital Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e., October 14, 2026, has considered and approved the Raising of funds up to Rs. 4,000 crore.
